reasoning_content: Looking at the fa2.log file, it seems `just serve` printed the URL table and completed (it exited after the serve process — because app's serve finished). Let me check the full log. Actually, this is probably the standard behavior: `just serve --apps=app` started, the app dev server exited (because of stdin / OOM), the recipe printed the table and exited. Or, `just serve`'s superviseStartup may have exited after a crash. Let me look at the full log.

action.command: cat /tmp/fa2.log | head -30; echo "=== app.log tail ==="; tail -12 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/app.log
